theory.title: Future forms: will, going to and present continuous
theory.explanation: Use going to for intentions and predictions based on present evidence. Use will for spontaneous decisions, offers and predictions based on opinion. Use the present continuous for fixed personal arrangements.
theory.tip: Fíjate en las referencias temporales y en la intención de quien habla. El contexto suele indicar qué estructura necesitas.

content.passage: The language club is organising a study trip for next month. The group is meeting at the station at eight on Saturday, and the teacher has already booked the tickets. Dark clouds are gathering, so it is going to rain later. One student has forgotten her lunch, but another student will share some food with her. The organisers are going to send a final message on Friday with the meeting point and emergency contact details. Everyone is looking forward to the visit.
